summary: Recent updates to the graphics configuration in Firefox have introduced improved support for High Dynamic Range (HDR) video rendering on Wayland, a display server protocol. Now, the browser can better utilize the capabilities of the WebRender engine to enhance the visual quality of HDR content. Additionally, users can benefit from a more granular control over how WebRender interacts with ANGLE, a compatibility layer that translates graphics APIs, which is particularly important for Metal graphics on macOS. These changes are designed to streamline performance and graphics fidelity, ensuring that users have a better viewing experience. **Overall, these enhancements prioritize delivering high-quality visual media across platforms.**
